title: ARS — Arithmetic Resonance Spectrograph
description:
A calibrated multi-scale random-matrix-theory readout for arbitrary time series. ARS embeds a sequence into a chirp signal, runs a GPU-parallel bank of Farey-rational phase-locked loops against it, and extracts passage-time spacings that are unfolded and compared against random matrix theory predictions (Wigner GOE / GUE / Poisson). Validated against the Riemann ζ zeros and the Katz–Sarnak family symmetry of elliptic curve L-functions.

The repository also contains llmspec/, Shapes of LLM weights over training: a pre-registered study of language-model weight spectra across training (Pythia 70M–1.4B with PolyPythias seeds, OLMo 2 1B), with five own 70M training runs comparing learning-rate warmups and AdamW vs Muon (Arm B). Start at llmspec/README.md.

It also contains specarith/, a spectral–arithmetic programme. Its Phase 6 is a pre-registered, sealed prime-spectroscopy instrument: exact explicit-formula and Selberg trace-formula identities on the Riemann zeros, the zeros of L(s, χ−4) and the Maass spectrum of PSL(2,ℤ), a least-squares readout of prime-power line amplitudes, random-matrix nulls and picket-fence confusables. All calibration gates pass (seal PH6_SEAL_6.0; results in specarith/ph6/PH6_FINDINGS.md, including the instrument's detection floor). The calibrated instrument then read every testable published xp-type model (Sierra–Rodríguez-Laguna, Berry–Keating 2011, Sierra–Townsend; seal PH6_SEAL_6.1, specarith/ph6/PH6_1_FINDINGS.md): each reproduces its own paper's counting constant, and each fails the primes — no line at any log pk and no spurious line — being locally an integrable crystal. Phase 2 tests the Bogomolny–Bohigas–Leboeuf–Monastra finite-size law on Odlyzko and Platt zeros (seal PH2_SEAL_2.1): at heights 105–3·1010 the O(N−2)-truncated law under-describes the nearest-neighbour spacing distribution at 0.5–1% precision (specarith/ph2/PH2_FINDINGS.md). Its second part (seal PH2R2_SEAL_1.0) measures the amplitude μ of the Conrey–Snaith (Bogomolny–Keating) arithmetic lower-order term in the zeros' pair correlation at five fresh heights (7·106–2·1010): μ̂ = 1 within 0.01 in every bin, pooled 1.003 ± 0.006, the leading order alone rejected everywhere — an independent quantitative replication, conditional on the ratios conjecture (specarith/ph2r2/PH2R2_FINDINGS.md). Start at specarith/ph6/PH6_FINDINGS.md.
